name: Kingdom & early Republic
blurb: Villages on the hills merge into a city. The Forum is drained, the Capitoline temple rises, and the Servian Wall is built.

name: Republic
blurb: Rome conquers the Mediterranean. Basilicas, aqueducts, and the first great theatres reshape the centre.

name: Early Empire
blurb: Augustus finds a city of brick and leaves one of marble. The Colosseum, Pantheon, and imperial fora are built.

name: Late Empire
blurb: Vast baths and the Aurelian Wall; Christian basilicas begin to appear alongside pagan temples.

name: Medieval
blurb: The population collapses and ruins become quarries and pastures. Churches and fortified towers dot the old city.

name: Renaissance & Baroque
blurb: Popes rebuild Rome: St. Peter's, piazzas, fountains, and Bernini's theatrical city.

name: Modern
blurb: Capital of a unified Italy. Excavations uncover the ancient city beneath new boulevards and monuments.
